A1.justification: Both 45-page PDFs describe the same AES research and contain readable text, figures, tables, equations and Appendices A–C. Text comparison and rendering support a reliable comparison; pages 6–45 are visually identical.

before.justification: v2 reports original reinforcement-learning experiments across 12 tasks, including performance and recovery results in Tables 2–3 and ablation and sensitivity results in Appendix B.

after.justification: v3 retains the original reinforcement-learning experiments and numerical outcomes in Section 4 and Appendix B, including Tables 2–7.

M1.justification: AES retains the same TD-error proxy, smoothing, accumulated-proxy square-root schedule and clipping. Its integration into SAC, PPO, SQL and MEow is unchanged in Table 1 and Appendix C.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same 12 tasks across Toy 2D multi-goal, MuJoCo and Isaac Gym, using the same Steady, Abrupt, Linear, Periodic and Mixed conditions.

E2.justification: Tables 2–3 retain SAC, PPO, SQL and MEow and their AES counterparts. Table 4 retains the same fixed-entropy, heuristic linear-schedule, component-removal and alternative-proxy comparisons.

E3.justification: Sections 4.1–4.2 and Appendix C retain the same drift schedules, step alignment, metrics, hyperparameters and evaluation procedures, including evaluation every 10,000 environment steps using 10 deterministic-policy episodes.

E4.justification: Appendix B retains the same coupling, clipping and proxy ablations and the same sensitivity analyses for TD-error quantiles, EMA smoothing and clipping ranges (Tables 4–7). No analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Both versions specify five random seeds, numbered 1–5, in Appendix C.8 and retain the same averaging and uncertainty-reporting statements. No statistical estimation procedure or uncertainty reporting is added or revised.

E6.justification: All numerical entries and associated findings in Tables 2–7 are unchanged, including normalized AUC, performance-drop ratios, recovery times and ablation/sensitivity outcomes. No result is added, removed or corrected.

T1.justification: Section 3 and Appendix A retain the same definitions, assumptions, regret bounds, proxy calibration, RL bridge and proofs. Early equations move with pagination, but their mathematical content is unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about variation-aware entropy scheduling, square-root scaling, improved robustness and faster recovery across four algorithm carriers and 12 tasks.

C2.justification: The interpretations and qualifications are unchanged, including treating TD errors as an alarm rather than an exact drift estimator and distinguishing the planning-version bound from a complete deep-RL learning guarantee. Section 4 and Appendix B retain the same empirical interpretations.

D1.justification: v3 adds a page-1 footnote identifying the AES GitHub repository as the location of code and supplementary material; v2 has no such access information. Appendix C's implementation and configuration details are unchanged. The PDFs establish the new pointer, not the repository's contents or functionality.

R1.justification: Section 2, Appendix B.7 and the bibliography retain the same cited works and research positioning. The new publication notice and code link do not revise the relationship to prior research.

P1.justification: v3 adds a short resource footnote and replaces the page-1 preprint notice with ICML/PMLR proceedings and copyright information. The version/date stamp also changes; scientific prose, headings and narrative organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The expanded first-page footnote and publication block alter spacing and reflow existing text and equations through page 5, including moving Equation (13) onto page 5. Figure 1 and all eight tables are unchanged; rendered pages 6–45 match exactly.

improvement.justification: The new page-1 code and supplementary-material pointer modestly improves reproducibility guidance by providing an explicit access location absent in v2. Methods, proofs, empirical evidence and appendix details are unchanged, so the benefit is limited to access information; the PDFs do not verify the linked materials.
